## Problem
`tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py::test_rebased_content_equivalent_branch_reports_merged` is flaky under Linux CI. Its fake `git credential` arm emits a password and exits without consuming the credential request on stdin, while `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-inventory.sh` runs `printf ... | git credential fill` under `set -o pipefail`. If the reader exits first, the producer receives SIGPIPE and the script reports `credential fill failed`.

## Evidence
- Gerrit 2957 / CI run 34439576412 / job 102752081573 failed only this test after 20,254 passes: returncode 2, stderr `credential fill failed`, git calls `credential fill`.
- The exact 2957 patch set passes the target test locally and changes only five unrelated comment/docstring files.
- A fixed 10,000-run reproduction of the same small `printf | non-reading credential stub` pipeline produced 5 failures with no code changes, confirming the scheduling race.
- Earlier bug 46be-40e8-db3f-4597 fixed a distinct inherited-BASH_ENV failure in this test; its improved diagnostics exposed this separate pipe-consumption defect.

## Plan
- Make the fake credential helper consume the complete stdin request before emitting its response, matching real `git credential fill`.
- Add deterministic evidence that the credential path cannot fail from a writer-side SIGPIPE under the test harness.
- Verify the focused feature-branch inventory tests under Linux/Bash and the project CI gate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The fake credential helper consumes the credential request before returning.
- [x] A deterministic regression oracle covers the pipefail/SIGPIPE failure class.
- [x] The focused feature-branch inventory tests pass under the CI shell environment.
- [x] Gerrit LLM-Review and Verified pass before merge.

## Scope note
This behavioral test-harness fix is intentionally excluded from the active comments/documentation-only epic.
